source: Ghana Revenue Authority, PAYE, resident individual bands for Year of Assessment 2026 (https://gra.gov.gh/domestic-tax/tax-types/paye/), read 2026-11-05. Monthly: first 588 at 0%, next 80 at 5%, next 100 at 10%, next 2,900 at 17.5%, next 16,000 at 25%, next 30,332 at 30%, above 50,000 at 35%; annual table is 12 times these. The page says 'These rates took effect September 1st, 2026' under the annual table. Not modelled: reliefs (none applied here: pass taxable pay after SSNIT and other deductions) and the flat 25% for non-residents. Amending acts listed on the page: Act 1178 (2026) and Act 1071 (2021); their text was not read.
